title: There's not a lid I can't open with these tools
text: There's not a lid I can't open with these tools. I would recommend them. I got a set for my mother. IDK what they're doing to soda bottle lids, but I'd swear they weld them on. With the small gadget you can get the stubbornest lid off. No more waiting for a man to come by.
